simple.summary: חַדּוּד (chaddûwd) means a point First listed occurrence: Job 41 22.

definitions.full: H2303. chaddud [ חַדּוּד ] adjective sharpened, sharp, pointed , only construct, with superlative sense = substantive: חָ֑רֶשׁ חַדּוּדֵי תַּחְתָּיו Job 41:22 beneath him the sharpest of potsherds , of scales of crocodile, compare Di VB.
